colecoes.descricao_html: Harness, water bottle and grooming glove, the whole walking kit with their name on the harness.
The no-pull harness in five sizes and four colours, personalised.
Grooming glove and travel water bottle to round out the kit.
Cold-weather coat cut to fit over the harness.

produtos.descricao_html:
Front and back D-rings redirect the pull instead of restraining it. Padded Y-front keeps pressure off the throat. Four adjustment points for a real fit, reinforced bar-tack stitching where cheap harnesses fail. Their name is heat-pressed and washable, and it's included, never an extra fee.

  • Front clip that actually stops the pulling
  • Padded Y-front, no pressure on the throat
  • Four adjustment points for a true fit
  • Their name, heat-pressed and washable, included
  • 30-day free size exchange
produtos.seo_titulo: Personalised No-Pull Dog Harness | Dear Bron
produtos.seo_descricao: A no-pull harness sized to your dog, finished with their name. Free personalisation, tracked worldwide shipping, 30-day fit guarantee.

pdp.eyebrow: The walking kit with their name on it
pdp.lede: A no-pull harness sized to your dog, hand-finished with their name.

produtos.descricao_html:
Soft silicone tips lift loose hair without pulling. Fits either hand, rinses clean, doubles as a bath-time massage mitt.

  • Gets the undercoat before it hits your floor
  • No pulling, no scratching
  • One size, either hand
produtos.seo_descricao: A silicone grooming glove that lifts loose fur in minutes. Add it to your Dear Bron order.

pdp.lede: Gets the loose undercoat off in a couple of minutes, on the sofa or in the garden.

produtos.descricao_html:
Squeeze to fill the tray, release to draw the water back, no waste. Folds flat for a pocket or lead bag. BPA-free.

  • One-handed, on the move
  • Folds flat, clips to the lead
  • Leak-proof lock
produtos.seo_titulo: Collapsible Dog Travel Water Bottle | Dear Bron
produtos.seo_descricao: A leak-proof, fold-flat dog water bottle for every walk. Matches your Dear Bron kit.

pdp.lede: Leak-proof bottle that folds flat and pours into its own bowl, one-handed.

produtos.descricao_html:
Step-in cut with a harness opening on the back, so the lead still clips straight to the front ring. Fleece lining, wind-resistant outer, reflective trim for dark mornings.

  • Harness hole, no re-clipping
  • Fleece lined, wind-resistant
  • Reflective trim
produtos.seo_titulo: Winter Warm Dog Coat | Dear Bron
produtos.seo_descricao: A fleece-lined, water-resistant dog coat with a harness opening. Built for cold-weather walks.

pdp.lede: Fleece-lined, water-resistant shell that clips over the harness without a fight.

paginas.corpo_html: Email hello@dearbron.com, we reply within one working day.
We ship worldwide, tracked. Standard delivery 6 to 10 working days. Personalised items add 2 to 4 working days. Free delivery over $40, otherwise $4.95.
30-day fit guarantee: wrong size, free swap. Unused non-personalised items refundable within 30 days. Personalised items only replaced if faulty.
Dear Bron collects only the data needed to fulfil your order and, with consent, to send marketing. GDPR/PECR compliant for UK/EU visitors. Full policy on request at hello@dearbron.com.

sequencia.prompt:
CONTEXTO: fotografia comercial de e-commerce, banner de home premium de acessórios para cães.

REFERÊNCIA A ANEXAR: a foto real do peitoral (Product Master, a produzir com a amostra) + uma foto de cena de passeio.

A PERSONA: dono de cão de 30 a 50 anos, casual, num passeio de fim de tarde, sem rosto em primeiro plano.

A CENA: cão de médio porte usando o peitoral Dear Bron na cor Moss, meio-passo, coleira frouxa, calçada molhada ou grama, luz dourada de fim de tarde, foco no cão.

MUNDO DA MARCA: paleta Moss #7D8A5C, Terracotta #C56A44, Sand #E8DDC9 expressa como ambiente real (folhagem, terra, luz quente), nunca gráfico pintado.

ZONA DE TEXTO: reservar o terço esquerdo pro headline e o CTA, sem elemento competindo ali.

FOTORREALISMO + FORMATO: qualidade de catálogo comercial, sem aparência de IA, sem pele plástica, sem texto. Landscape 16:9, 1920x1080px.
